name: application-hover-preview-card
title: Hover Preview Card
description: Inline text link that reveals a rich preview popover (badge, title, description) above it on hover, using CSS group-hover rather than JS-driven positioning.
useWhen: An inline link references external content (an article, a doc, a resource) worth previewing without navigating away.
You want a lightweight, CSS-only hover reveal rather than a JS positioning library or a click-triggered popover.
The preview content is short enough to read at a glance (a title, one description line, a small badge/thumbnail).
avoidWhen: You're previewing a person/user profile specifically — use `person-hovercard` for that richer, person-specific layout.
The trigger needs to work on touch devices where hover doesn't exist — pair with a tap-to-open fallback or use a click-triggered popover instead.
The preview content is long or interactive (forms, multiple actions) — a hover popover that requires sustained pointer position is the wrong pattern for that; use a click-opened panel.
responsiveBehavior: The popover is centered above its trigger via absolute positioning and a fixed width; it does not reflow with viewport size, so on narrow viewports ensure the trigger isn't near a screen edge.
accessibility: The popover carries role=tooltip so assistive tech announces it as supplementary information tied to the link.
Visibility is toggled with both `invisible`/`visible` and `opacity`, so the popover is removed from the accessibility tree and hit-testing when hidden, not just made transparent.
The popover has pointer-events-none, preventing it from intercepting clicks or shifting layout when the pointer passes near but not directly over the trigger.

variants.title: Hover Preview Card
variants.description: An inline "Refactoring UI" link inside a sentence, revealing a badge + title + description popover on hover.
accessibility: The reveal is driven by CSS group-hover rather than JS mouseenter/mouseleave timers, so there is no risk of a lingering popover if a state-update is missed.

variants.title: Hover Preview Card (Dark)
variants.description: Hover preview card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: The popover surface is lifted one step above the page background (gray-800 on gray-900) so its shadow and border remain perceptible against the dark surface.
